BillHeading.BriefDescription: Requiring school districts of the first class to employ a school nurse.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring school districts of the first class to employ a school nurse; and amending RCW 28A.210.300.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 28A.210.300 and 1975 c 43 s 20 are each amended to read as follows:School physician or school nurse may be employed.
BillSection.P: (1) The board of directors of any school district of the second class, as provided in RCW 28A.300.065, may employ a regularly licensed physician or a licensed public health nurse, a registered nurse, or an advanced registered nurse practitioner for the purpose of protecting the health of the children students in said district.

P.TextRun: (2)(a) The board of directors of any school district of the first class, as provided in RCW 28A.300.065, must employ a school nurse for the purpose of protecting the health of the students in said district.

(b) For the purposes of this subsection, "school nurse" means a registered nurse or an advanced registered nurse practitioner who holds a valid educational staff associate certificate for school nurses.
